title: Keel Muhasay (Acne): Wajohat, Kya Karein Aur Kya Na Karein
summary: Keel muhasay kyun nikalte hain, kis ko zyada hote hain, khane ka kitna kirdar hai, ghar par kya karna theek hai aur kab dermatologist se milna chahiye. AAD aur NIH ke hawalon ke saath.
evidenceLevel: American Academy of Dermatology, NIH NIAMS

tableOfContents.title: 5. Khane ka kitna kirdar hai? Sach yeh hai
6. Ghar par kya karein (jo waqai kaam karta hai)

content:
Key Takeaways

  • Acne tab hota hai jab jild ke pores (chhote surakh) tel, murda khaal aur bacteria se band ho jate hain. Gandagi is ki wajah nahi.
  • AAD ke mutabiq 12 se 24 saal ke tehreeban 85 fisad logon ko kabhi na kabhi acne hota hai, aur barhi umar ki khawateen mein bhi yeh aam hai.
  • Din mein zyada se zyada do baar narm face wash, phoonsi na dabayen, aur chehre aur baalon ke liye oil-free cheezein istemal karein.
  • Dukaan ki dawa ko asar dikhane mein kai hafte se chand mahine lag sakte hain. Dard wali gilthiyan ya nishaan ban rahe hon to dermatologist se milein.

1. Keel muhasay hote kyun hain?

Chehre par jo phoonsi nikalti hai us ki kahani jild ke andar shuru hoti hai. NIH ke NIAMS ke mutabiq jild ke pores mein tel (sebum) aur murda khaal jama ho kar rasta band kar deti hai, phir us mein bacteria barhte hain aur sozish ho jati hai. Yani teen cheezein: zyada tel, murda khaal aur bacteria.

Tel zyada kyun banta hai? Hormones ki wajah se. Jawani mein androgen hormones barhte hain jo tel ki glands ko bara kar dete hain, is liye larke larkiyan dono is umar mein pareshan hote hain. Hamal mein hormones ki tabdeeli se bhi acne ho sakta hai.

NIAMS ke mutabiq agar walidain ko acne tha to aulad ko hone ka imkaan zyada hota hai. Kuch dawaein, jaise hormone wali dawaein, corticosteroids aur lithium, bhi acne kar sakti hain. Aur ek baat saaf: gandagi acne ki wajah nahi. Blackhead kala is liye lagta hai ke hawa lagne se tel ka rang badal jata hai, mail ki wajah se nahi.

2. Kis ko zyada hota hai?

American Academy of Dermatology (AAD) ke mutabiq 12 se 24 saal ke tehreeban 85 fisad log kam ya zyada acne ka samna karte hain.

NIAMS ke mutabiq teenage mein larkon mein zyada aur barhi umar mein khawateen mein zyada hota hai. AAD likhta hai ke adult acne wali khawateen mein se tehreeban 20 se 40 fisad ko pehli baar acne bari umar mein hi hota hai. Aksar logon ka acne tees saal ki umar tak khatam ho jata hai, magar kuch logon ko chalees pachaas mein bhi rehta hai.

3. Phoonsi ki qismein pehchanein

Whitehead: band pore jo khaal ke neeche safed dana banata hai. Blackhead: wohi band pore jo khaal ki satah tak aa kar khul jata hai aur kala lagta hai. Papule: chhota gulabi dana jo chhoone se dukhta hai. Pustule: jis par safed ya peeli peep ho.

Nodule: bari, sakht aur dard wali gilthi jo jild ke andar gehri hoti hai. Severe nodular acne, jisay log cystic acne kehte hain, mein gehri peep wali dard bhari gilthiyan hoti hain. In do qismon mein doctor zaroori hai.

4. Kya cheezein acne barhati hain?

AAD ke mutabiq stress acne ki wajah nahi banta magar mojooda acne ko bigaar sakta hai, aur jitna stress zyada, acne utna zyada. Kam neend bhi acne barha sakti hai.

Tel wala makeup aur baalon ka tel ya pomade jo chehre tak aaye, dono acne barhate hain. Hamare yahan raat ko baalon mein tel laga kar sone ka riwaj hai; mathay par daanay hon to baal chehre se door rakhein.

NIAMS ke mutabiq helmet, tight kapron ya bag ke patte ka dabao, zyada nami aur pollution, phoonsi dabana ya chhilna, aur chehre ko zor se ragarna bhi acne bigaarte hain. AAD ke mutabiq kuch studies mein cigarette peene walon mein acne zyada paaya gaya.

5. Khane ka kitna kirdar hai? Sach yeh hai

AAD ke mutabiq chhoti studies yeh ishara karti hain ke low-glycemic khuraak (kam cheeni, kam safed roti aur chawal, zyada sabzi, daal aur phal) acne kam kar sakti hai, magar dosri studies mein yeh taluq nahi mila. AAD khud kehta hai ke pakka jaanne ke liye mazeed research chahiye.

Gaye ke doodh ke baare mein kuch studies mein acne barhne ka taluq mila hai, magar dahi aur paneer ke saath aisa taluq nahi mila. Chocolate aur tali hui cheezon ke baare mein mazboot saboot nahi.

AAD ki bottom line yeh hai ke sirf khana badalne se jild saaf nahi hoti, is ke saath sahi skin care bhi chahiye.

6. Ghar par kya karein (jo waqai kaam karta hai)

AAD ke mutabiq chehra din mein zyada se zyada do baar aur paseena aane ke baad dhoyen, narm face wash se, sirf ungliyon se. Towel, sponge ya scrub se ragarna jild ko irritate karta hai. Alcohol-free cheezein chunein aur toner, astringent aur exfoliant se bachein kyunke yeh jild khushk kar ke acne ko aur bura dikhate hain.

Baal tel wale hon to shampoo zyada baar karein aur baal chehre se door rakhein. Haath baar baar chehre par na lagayein. Aur sab se ahem: phoonsi na dabayen, na choren. AAD ke mutabiq is se acne der se theek hota hai aur nishaan aur kale dhabbe parne ka khatra barhta hai.

Dukaan se milne wali dawaon mein NIAMS benzoyl peroxide (jo bacteria marta hai) aur salicylic acid (jo blackhead whitehead kholta hai) ka zikr karta hai. Magar sabar chahiye: AAD ke mutabiq asar dikhne mein kai hafte se chand mahine lagte hain, aur baar baar product badalne se acne bigar sakta hai.

Besan, haldi, toothpaste aur is tarah ke totkon ke liye koi mazboot evidence nahi, aur kuch cheezein jild ko irritate kar sakti hain.

7. Dhoop, kale dhabbe aur nishaan

Acne ke baad jo kale dhabbe reh jate hain unhein post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation kehte hain, aur NIAMS ke mutabiq gehri rangat wali jild mein yeh zyada hote hain. Is liye hamare liye sunscreen aur bhi zaroori hai.

AAD ke mutabiq aisa sunscreen lein jis par "non-comedogenic" ya "wont clog pores" likha ho, SPF 30 ya zyada. Dhoop mein jild jalne se bachein, kyunke acne ki bohat si dawaein jild ko dhoop ke liye zyada hassaas kar deti hain.

8. Dermatologist se kab milein

AAD kehta hai ke agar upar wali baatein apnane ke baad bhi daanay nikalte rahein to dermatologist se milein. Dard wali gilthiyan, nishaan banna, ya aisa acne jo aap ko logon se milne se rokta ho, yeh sab doctor ke paas jane ki wajah hain.

Doctor ke paas prescription ki dawaein hoti hain: topical retinoids, antibiotics, isotretinoin, aur khawateen ke liye hormone therapy. Yeh sab doctor ki nigrani mein hi li jati hain, kisi ke kehne par ya dukaan se khud nahi.

title: Iron Wale Desi Khanay: Khoon Ki Kami Mein Kya Khayen Aur Kaise Pakayen Ke Iron Jazb Ho
summary: Daal, palak, kaleji, khajoor aur gur: kaun se desi khanay iron dete hain, kitna iron chahiye, aur pakane aur khane ka wo tareeqa jis se iron jism mein jazb bhi ho. Hawalon ke saath.

tableOfContents.title: 1. Pehle yeh samjhein: iron kitna chahiye aur masla kitna bara hai
2. Gosht wala iron aur daal wala iron: farq kya hai?
3. Desi khanay jin mein iron hota hai
4. Paanch asaan desi tarkeebein jo iron bhi dein aur jazb bhi karayein
5. Jo cheezein iron ka jazb kam karti hain
6. Bachon aur khawateen ke liye khaas baatein

content:
Key Takeaways

  • National Nutrition Survey 2018 ke mutabiq Pakistan mein bachay paidaish ki umar ki 40 fisad se zyada khawateen anemic hain, aur chhote bachon mein anemia is se bhi zyada aam hai.
  • MedlinePlus ke mutabiq 19 se 50 saal ki khawateen ko roz 18 mg iron chahiye, mardon ko 8 mg, aur hamal mein 27 mg.
  • Daal, chanay aur palak ka iron gosht ke iron se mushkil jazb hota hai. Nimbu ya tamatar ke saath khayen, aur khane ke foran baad chai na peeyen.
  • Daal ke saath thora gosht ya murghi shamil karne se sabzi wale iron ka jazb teen guna tak barh sakta hai.

1. Pehle yeh samjhein: iron kitna chahiye aur masla kitna bara hai

Hamare ghar mein jab kisi ko thakan, chakkar ya rang peela lagta hai to pehla jumla yehi hota hai: "khoon ki kami hai, kuch khilao". Baat ghalat nahi, magar sawal yeh hai ke kya khilayein aur kaise, kyunke har iron wala khana jism mein barabar jazb nahi hota.

UNICEF ke National Nutrition Survey 2018 ke mutabiq Pakistan mein bachay paidaish ki umar ki 40 fisad se zyada khawateen anemic hain, aur paanch saal se chhote bachon mein anemia aur bhi aam hai. Yani yeh chand gharon ka nahi, poore mulk ka masla hai.

MedlinePlus (NIH) ke mutabiq 19 se 50 saal ki khawateen ko roz 18 mg iron chahiye, jab ke mardon ko sirf 8 mg. Hamal mein zaroorat 27 mg tak chali jati hai, aur 14 se 18 saal ki larkiyon ko 15 mg. Farq itna bara is liye hai ke mahwari ke saath har mahine iron ka nuqsan hota hai.

2. Gosht wala iron aur daal wala iron: farq kya hai?

Khuraak mein iron do tarah ka hota hai. Gosht, murghi, machli aur kaleji wala iron jism aasani se jazb kar leta hai. Daal, chanay, palak, khajoor aur anaaj wala iron mojood to hota hai magar MedlinePlus ke mutabiq jism ke liye isay jazb karna mushkil hota hai.

Is ka matlab yeh nahi ke daal palak bekaar hain. Matlab sirf yeh hai ke sabzi aur daal wale iron ko sahi saathi chahiye. Agli sections mein yehi saathi batayenge, aur yeh sab cheezen hamare bazaar mein roz milti hain.

3. Desi khanay jin mein iron hota hai

Gosht aur anday ki taraf se: kaleji, lean beef aur mutton, murghi ka gehra (raan wala) gosht, machli jaise tuna aur salmon, aur anday khaaskar zardi. MedlinePlus in sab ko iron ke behtareen zariyon mein shumar karta hai.

Daalon aur phalion mein: masoor, chana, lobia, soybean aur sookhi phaliyan. Sabziyon mein palak, sarson ka saag, broccoli aur dosri hari pattay wali sabziyan. Sookhe mewon mein khubani, kishmish aur aloo bukhara jaise sookhe phal, aur badam.

Anaaj mein poora gandum (chokar wala atta), bajra, jau aur brown rice. Jo cereals ya atta "iron fortified" likh kar aata hai wo bhi iron deta hai, label dekh lein. Aur ek baat jo bohat log nahi jaante: MedlinePlus ke mutabiq doodh iron ka bohat kamzor zariya hai.

4. Paanch asaan desi tarkeebein jo iron bhi dein aur jazb bhi karayein

Masoor ki daal, upar nimbu nichora hua aur saath tamatar pyaz ka salad. Daal ka iron aur nimbu tamatar ka vitamin C ek saath, yeh sab se sasti aur asaan jori hai.

Palak gosht ya palak murghi. MedlinePlus ke mutabiq hari sabzi ke saath thora gosht, machli ya murghi khane se sabzi wale iron ka jazb teen guna tak barh sakta hai. Yani palak gosht sirf zaiqe ka nahi, hisaab ka bhi kamal hai.

Chanay ki chaat: ublay chanay, tamatar, hari mirch, dhania aur khoob nimbu. Shaam ki bhook ke liye chips ki jagah yeh rakhein.

Anday ki bhurji tamatar ke saath, aur saath chokar wale atte ki roti. Zardi iron deti hai, tamatar jazb mein madad.

Nashte mein dalia ya oats, upar kati hui khubani, kishmish aur chand badam. Agar loha (cast iron) ki karahi ya tawa ghar mein hai to us mein pakayen; MedlinePlus ke mutabiq is se khane mein iron ki miqdar barh sakti hai.

5. Jo cheezein iron ka jazb kam karti hain

Sab se bari: chai. MedlinePlus ke mutabiq kali chai mein aisi cheezein hoti hain jo khane ke iron se jur jati hain aur jism usay jazb nahi kar pata. Hamare yahan khane ke foran baad chai ka riwaj hai, isi liye daal palak kha kar bhi faida kam milta hai. Khane aur chai ke darmiyan kam az kam ek ghante ka waqfa rakhein.

NIH ke mutabiq calcium bhi iron ke jazb mein rukawat dal sakta hai, is liye iron wale khane ke saath bohat zyada doodh ya dahi na lein, doodh ko alag waqt par rakhein.

Aur jo cheez jazb barhati hai wo vitamin C hai: nimbu, kinnu, amrood, tamatar, shimla mirch aur aloo. Har iron wale khane mein in mein se ek shamil kar lein.

6. Bachon aur khawateen ke liye khaas baatein

MedlinePlus ke mutabiq bachon ko tehreeban chhe mahine ka iron paidaishi milta hai; is ke baad unhein iron wali khuraak ya doctor ke mashware se iron fortified cheezein chahiye. Ek se chaar saal ke bachon ko din mein do se teen cup doodh kaafi hai; is se bohat zyada doodh pilane se "milk anemia" ho sakta hai, kyunke doodh pait bhar deta hai aur iron nahi deta.

Jin khawateen ki mahwari bhari hoti hai, jo hamil hain ya haal mein bacha hua hai, unhein sab se zyada khatra hota hai. In ke liye sirf khuraak kaafi nahi ho sakti, test zaroori hai.

Iron ki goliyan bachon ki pohanch se door rakhein. MedlinePlus ke mutabiq bachay zyada iron ki goliyan ya syrup nigal kar iron poisoning ka shikar ho sakte hain.

7. Doctor se kab milein

Agar thakan hafton se hai, saans phoolti hai, sar dard aur chakkar rehte hain, naakhun chamche ki tarah dhanste ja rahe hain, ya mahwari bohat bhari hai to CBC aur ferritin test karwa lein. Doctor hi batayega ke kami kitni hai aur wajah khuraak hai ya kahin se khoon beh raha hai.

Iron ki goliyan test ke baghair khud na shuru karein. Khuraak ki tabdeeli har koi aaj se kar sakta hai, magar dose aur muddat doctor ka faisla hai.

  • UNICEF Pakistan: National Nutrition Survey 2018, Key Findings Report
  • Dawn (2019): Pakistan faces nutrition emergency, NNS 2018 findings
  • NIH Office of Dietary Supplements: Iron fact sheet for consumers

title: Lehsan Ke Faiday: Cholesterol, BP Aur Zukam Mein Kitna Sach Hai
summary: Lehsan har ghar mein hai aur kai daawe mashhoor hain. NCCIH (NIH) ke mutabiq cholesterol, BP aur zukam par kitna evidence hai aur kab ehtiyat karein.

tableOfContents.title: 6. Ehtiyat: kab masla ho sakta hai
7. Roz ke khane mein kaise shamil karein

content:
Key Takeaways

  • NCCIH ke mutabiq lehsan ke supplements cholesterol ko thora sa kam kar sakte hain, un logon mein jin ka cholesterol zyada ho.
  • Blood pressure par evidence mehdood hai aur asar chhota ho sakta hai.
  • Zukam rokne ke daawe par research bohat kam hai.
  • Lehsan ke supplements khoon behne ka khatra barha sakte hain, khaas tor par khoon patla karne wali dawaon ya surgery se pehle.

1. Lehsan: har salan ka saathi

Lehsan ke baghair hamara salan, biryani aur chutney adhoori lagte hain. Saath hi ghar ghar mein suna jata hai ke "kacha lehsan khao to cholesterol aur BP theek, zukam bhi door". In baaton mein kitna sach hai, yeh dekhna zaroori hai.

Hum yahan NIH ke National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH) ke garlic fact sheet ko bunyad bana rahe hain, jo February 2025 mein update hua. Is mein lehsan ki koi khaas miqdar nahi batayi gayi, is liye hum bhi koi "roz itni kaliyan" ka hisaab nahi likh rahe.

2. Cholesterol par asar

NCCIH ke mutabiq garlic supplements un logon mein total aur LDL ("bura") cholesterol ko thora sa kam kar sakte hain jin ka cholesterol pehle se zyada ho. Yaad rahe, yeh "thora sa" kami hai, aur baat supplements ki ho rahi hai, khane mein daale gaye lehsan ki nahi.

Isliye lehsan ko cholesterol ki dawa ya parhez ka badal na samjhein. Agar doctor ne dawa di hai to wo jari rakhein.

3. Blood pressure par asar

NCCIH likhta hai ke mehdood evidence ke mutabiq garlic supplements high BP wale logon mein BP ko thora sa kam kar sakte hain. Yaani evidence abhi mazboot nahi.

Agar BP ka masla hai to namak kam karna, harkat, wazan par qaboo aur doctor ki dawa zyada bharosemand raste hain. Lehsan khane mein daalna acha hai, magar BP ki dawa chhodne ka sabab nahi.

4. Zukam aur immunity ka daawa

Lehsan ko sardi ke mausam mein immune nizam ka "booster" kaha jata hai. NCCIH ke mutabiq is par research bohat kam hui hai, aur aik 2022 ke review mein sirf do chhoti study mili jo kisi mumkina faide ki taraf ishara karti thin, wo bhi kamzoriyon ke saath.

Is liye "lehsan khao, zukam nahi hoga" jaisa wada nahi kiya ja sakta. Zukam mein aaram, paani aur garam sup ki aadat apni jagah qaim hai.

5. Cancer ka daawa

Kuch jagah lehsan ko cancer se bachao se jora jata hai. NCCIH ke mutabiq lehsan khane se pait (stomach) ke cancer ka khatra kam hota nazar nahi aata, aur colorectal cancer ke bare mein pakka kuch kehna mumkin nahi.

Yani yahan bhi bara daawa karna sahi nahi.

6. Ehtiyat: kab masla ho sakta hai

Lehsan ke supplements ke aam side effects mein saans aur jism ki boo, pait dard, gas aur matli shamil hain. Kuch logon ko allergy bhi hoti hai.

NCCIH ke mutabiq garlic supplements khoon behne ka khatra barha sakte hain. Agar aap khoon patla karne wali dawa ya aspirin lete hain, ya surgery hone wali hai, to apne doctor ko lehsan ke supplements ke bare mein zaroor batayein. Hamal ya doodh pilane ke dauran khane ki miqdar se zyada lehsan lene se pehle bhi poochein.

Kacha lehsan jild par seedha na lagayein: NCCIH ke mutabiq is se jild mein shadeed jalan ya jalne jaise zakhm ho sakte hain.

7. Roz ke khane mein kaise shamil karein

Lehsan ko salan, dal ke tarke aur chutney mein shamil karna asaan aur lazzat bhara tareeqa hai. Namak aur tel ki jagah masalon se zaiqa laane mein bhi yeh madadgar hai.

Magar yahan maqsad khane ka zaiqa hai, ilaaj nahi. Supplement ke bajaye ghar ke khane mein istemal behtar aur sasta hai.

8. Doctor se kab milein?

Agar cholesterol ya BP ki dawa le rahe hain, khoon patla karne wali dawa chal rahi hai, surgery hone wali hai, ya lehsan khane ke baad shadeed pait dard ya allergy ho, to doctor se milein.

Seene mein dard, saans phoolna, honton ya chehre par soojan ya behoshi jaisi soorat mein fori emergency mein jayein.

title: Fatty Liver Kya Hai: Alamaat, Wajohat Aur Bachao Ke Tareeqay
summary: Jigar par charbi jama hona aksar khamoshi se hota hai. Wajohat, khatray ke asbab, wazan aur khuraak ke zariye bachao, NIDDK ke hawale se.
content:
Key Takeaways

  • Fatty liver mein jigar mein charbi jama ho jati hai, aur yeh zyada sharab ki wajah se nahi hoti.
  • Aksar koi alamat nahi hoti; kabhi kabhi thakan ya pait ke upar daayein taraf takleef ho sakti hai.
  • NIDDK ke mutabiq jism ke wazan ka kam az kam 3 se 5 fisad kam karna jigar ki charbi ghata sakta hai.
  • Tez wazan ghatana ya bhookay rehna nuqsan kar sakta hai. Aahista aur musalsal chalein.

1. Fatty liver hota kya hai?

Jigar hamare jism ka bohat zaroori angh hai. Jab is mein zaroorat se zyada charbi jama ho jaye aur is ki wajah zyada sharab na ho, to ise non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) kaha jata hai. Ab ise MASLD bhi kehte hain.

NIDDK ke mutabiq is ki do aam soorten hain. Aik mein sirf charbi hoti hai aur soojan ya nuqsan kam hota hai. Doosri soorat (NASH ya MASH) mein charbi ke saath soojan aur jigar ko nuqsan bhi hota hai, jo aage chal kar jigar ke zakhm (fibrosis), cirrhosis aur jigar ke cancer tak ja sakta hai. Maahireen abhi poori tarah nahi jaante ke kuch logon ko NASH kyun hota hai aur doosron ko nahi.

2. Kitna aam hai?

NIDDK ka andaza hai ke America mein tehreeban 24 fisad baalighon ko NAFLD hai. Yeh Amriki figure hai; Pakistan ke liye hum yahan koi figure nahi likh rahe kyunke wo humne verify nahi kiya.

NIDDK yeh bhi batata hai ke type 2 diabetes ke mareezon mein se aik tihai se do tihai tak ko NAFLD hota hai. Yani jin logon ko diabetes ya wazan ka masla hai unhein is ke bare mein zyada hoshyar rehna chahiye.

3. Alamaat: aksar khamoshi

Fatty liver ko aksar khamosh bimari kaha jata hai. NIDDK ke mutabiq zyada tar logon mein alamaat bohat kam ya bilkul nahi hotin, yahan tak ke NASH se cirrhosis ho jaye tab bhi.

Jab alamaat hon to thakan ya pait ke upar daayein hisse mein takleef ho sakti hai. Yeh alamaat bohat si dosri wajohat se bhi hoti hain, is liye khud faisla na karein, test karwayein.

4. Khatray ke asbab

NIDDK ke mutabiq moti ya wazan zyada hona, insulin resistance ya type 2 diabetes, khoon mein charbi (triglycerides, LDL) ka zyada ya HDL ka kam hona aur metabolic syndrome khatray ko barhate hain. Metabolic syndrome mein bari kamar, zyada triglycerides, kam HDL, high BP aur zyada blood sugar mein se koi teen cheezen shamil hain.

Kuch dawaen (maslan corticosteroids), bohat tez wazan girna aur ghiza ki shadeed kami bhi jigar mein charbi la sakti hain. Genes ka bhi kirdar ho sakta hai. Is liye doctor ko apni saari dawaen zaroor batayein.

5. Bachao: wazan aur harkat

NIDDK ke mutabiq wazan ka kam az kam 3 se 5 fisad kam karna jigar ki charbi kam kar sakta hai, aur soojan ya zakhm kam karne ke liye 7 se 10 fisad tak kami darkar ho sakti hai. Jismani harkat wazan kam hue baghair bhi faida deti hai.

Isi liye roz ki tez chal, baithe rehne ke waqt mein kami aur chhoti plate ka istemal bohat kaam aata hai. Meethi chai, soft drinks, mithai, talay hue snacks aur bare portion kam karna ghar ka sab se asaan qadam hai. Ghar ke saade khane jaise daal, sabzi aur roti ki nappi tuli miqdar acha aaghaz hain.

6. Aahista chalein

NIDDK khabardar karta hai ke tez wazan girna aur ghiza ki kami jigar ki bimari ko bigaad sakti hai. Is liye crash diet ya bhookay rehne wale nuskhay na apnayein; hafte mein thora thora wazan girna behtar hai.

Agar aap sharab peete hain to doctor se is bare mein saaf baat karein. NIDDK ke mutabiq jin logon mein khatray ke asbab hon aur wo zyada sharab bhi peeyen, unhein dono masle ek saath ho sakte hain.

7. Totkay aur supplements

NIDDK ka mashwara hai ke vitamin ya koi bhi supplement lene se pehle doctor se poochein, kyunke kuch herbal cheezen jigar ko nuqsan pohancha sakti hain. "Jigar saaf karne" ke dukaan ya hakeemi nuskhon par bina doctor ke bharosa na karein.

Dawa ka faisla doctor ka hai; hum yahan kisi dawa ya goli ka mashwara nahi de rahe, aur kisi ghareloo cheez se jigar "theek" hone ka wada nahi kar rahe.

8. Doctor se kab milein?

Agar aap ko diabetes, high BP, zyada charbi ya moti ka masla hai, to doctor se jigar ke test (maslan khoon ke test ya ultrasound) ke bare mein poochein, chahe koi alamat na ho. Aankhon ya jild ka peela pan, pait ya taangon mein soojan, musalsal bohat zyada thakan, ya pait ke upar daayein taraf takleef ho to jaldi milein.

Khoon ki ulti, kaala pakhana ya behoshi jaisi soorat mein fori emergency mein jayein.

  • NIDDK: Symptoms & Causes of NAFLD & NASH
  • NIDDK: Treatment for NAFLD & NASH

title: Mobile Aur Screen Se Aankhon Ki Thakan: Bachne Ke Asaan Tareeqay
summary: Der tak mobile ya computer dekhne se aankhein thak jati hain. 20-20-20 ka qaida, palken jhapakna, screen ka fasla aur kab aankhon ke doctor ko dikhana hai.
evidenceLevel: American Academy of Ophthalmology, American Optometric Association

tableOfContents.title: 2. Kya screen aankhein kharab kar deti hai?

content:
Key Takeaways

  • Screen dekhte waqt hum palken kam jhapakte hain, jis se aankhein thak sakti aur khushk ho sakti hain.
  • 20-20-20 qaida: har 20 minute baad 20 second ke liye 20 feet door dekhein.
  • AAO ke mutabiq screen ko tehreeban 25 inch (bazu ki lambai) door rakhna aur room ki roshni theek rakhna madadgar hai.
  • AAO blue light waale chashme ki sifarish scientific saboot ki kami ki wajah se nahi karta; waqfay lena behtar tareeqa hai.

1. Aankhein kyun thakti hain?

Mobile, laptop aur TV dekhna ab roz ka hissa hai. Aankhon ke doctors ke mutabiq jab hum screen par nazar jama kar rakhte hain to palken jhapakna bohat kam ho jata hai. Palak jhapakne se aankh par nami phailti hai, is liye kam jhapakne se aankhein khushk, thaki hui aur jalti hui mehsoos hoti hain.

Is kaifiyat ko digital eye strain ya computer vision syndrome kehte hain. Isme sar dard, dhundla nazar aana, khushk aankhein aur gardan ya kandhon ka dard shamil ho sakte hain.

2. Kya screen aankhein kharab kar deti hai?

American Academy of Ophthalmology (AAO) ke mutabiq screen se aksar waqti thakan aur takleef hoti hai. Yeh pakka saboot nahi ke screen aankh ki roshni ko hamesha ke liye kharab kar deti hai. Magar thakan se kaam aur neend dono mutasir hote hain, is liye iska bachao zaroori hai.

3. 20-20-20 ka qaida

Aankhon ke doctors ki do tanzeemein, AAO aur American Optometric Association, yeh asaan qaida batati hain: har 20 minute baad, 20 second ke liye, tehreeban 20 feet (6 meter) door kisi cheez ko dekhein. Misaal ke tor par khidki se bahar ya kamray ke doosre kone ko.

Dhyan rahe ke is qaide par tehqeeq abhi kam hai, aur wazahat se tamam nateeje saabit nahi. Magar waqfa lena aur door dekhna khatre se khaali aur asaan aadat hai. Alarm laga lein to yaad rehta hai.

4. Jaan boojh kar palken jhapkayein

Jab screen par kaam kar rahe hon to dhyan se kai baar jaldi jaldi palken jhapkayein. Yeh sunne mein ajeeb lagta hai magar aankhon ko nam rakhta hai. Agar aankhein bohat khushk rehti hon to doctor se poochein ke koi artificial tears (aankh ki boondein) theek rahengi ya nahi.

5. Screen ka fasla aur roshni

AAO ka mashwara hai ke computer ki screen tehreeban 25 inch yaani bazu ki lambai ke fasle par ho aur screen aap ki nazar se thori neeche ho, taake aap halka sa neeche dekhein. Mobile ko bhi bohat qareeb na pakdein.

Room ki roshni aur screen ki roshni mein bohat zyada farq na ho. Andhere kamre mein tez screen dekhna aankhon ko zyada thakata hai. Screen ki chamak aur text ka size apne aaram ke mutabiq badal lein.

6. Blue light chashme ka kya?

AAO blue light block karne waale chashme ki sifarish nahi karta kyunke is ke fayde ka scientific saboot kam hai. Is ke bajaye baar baar waqfa lena aur upar wale tareeqay apnana behtar bataya gaya hai. Is liye mehenge chashme se pehle yeh muft aadatein azmayein.

7. Bachon ke liye

Bachon ko bhi screen ke beech waqfa dein aur unhein kuch waqt bahar khelne ke liye bhejein. Roz ek hi kamre mein, andhere mein mobile na dekhne dein. Bacha baar baar aankh ragre, qareeb ho kar dekhe ya sar dard ki shikayat kare to aankhon ka test karwayein.

8. Doctor se kab milein?

Agar yeh sab karne ke baad bhi thakan, dhundla nazar ya sar dard barqarar rahe, to aankhon ke doctor se nazar check karwayein, kyunke kabhi nazar ka number ya chashma purana ho jata hai. Achanak nazar kam hona, aankh mein shadeed dard, laali, ya roshni ke gird halqay nazar aayen to foran aankhon ke doctor ya emergency se rujoo karein.

Hawalay (Sources)

  • American Academy of Ophthalmology: Are Blue Light-Blocking Glasses Worth It?
  • American Academy of Ophthalmology: Can Reading a Smartphone With One Eye Lead to Temporary Blindness?
  • American Optometric Association: Computer vision syndrome (Digital eye strain)
  • EyeWiki (AAO): Computer Vision Syndrome (Digital Eye Strain)

Note: Yeh maloomat sirf aam agahi ke liye hai, ilaj ka mutabadal nahi. Koi bimari, hamal, ya musalsal alamaat hon to doctor se zaroor mashwara karein.

title: Din Mein Kitni Chai Ya Coffee Theek Hai? Caffeine Ka Asaan Hisaab
summary: Chai ke shaukeen log jaan lein ke caffeine ki mehfooz had kya hai, hamal mein kitni kam rakhni chahiye, aur kab chai kam karni chahiye. FDA aur ACOG ke hawale se.

tableOfContents.title: 1. Chai ke bina subah nahi hoti
4. Hamal aur doodh pilane ke dauran

content:
Key Takeaways

  • FDA ke mutabiq sehatmand barhon ke liye roz 400 mg caffeine (tehreeban 4 se 5 cup coffee) aam tor par nuqsandeh nahi mani jati.
  • Hamal mein ACOG ke mutabiq 200 mg se kam caffeine miscarriage ya samay se pehle paidaish ki bari wajah nahi lagti.
  • Chai mein caffeine coffee se kam hoti hai, magar cheeni aur doodh ka hisaab alag se dekhna parta hai.
  • Ek dam chhodne se sar dard aur chidchidapan ho sakta hai, isliye aahista kam karein.

1. Chai ke bina subah nahi hoti

Hamare ghar mein chai sirf ek mashroob nahi, ek aadat hai. Subah, dopahar, shaam, mehman aaye to chai. Sawal yeh hai ke itni chai ka jism par kya asar parta hai, aur kya koi had hai jahan ruk jana behtar hai?

Chai, coffee, cola aur energy drinks sab mein caffeine hoti hai. Caffeine dimagh ko chusti deti hai aur neend door karti hai, isi liye hum isay pasand karte hain.

2. FDA ki batayi hui had

Amreeki idara FDA ke mutabiq sehatmand barhon ke liye roz tehreeban 400 milligram caffeine aisi miqdar hai jo aam tor par nuqsandeh asraat se nahi jori jati. Yeh tehreeban 4 se 5 cup coffee ke barabar bataya jata hai.

Yeh koi sakht hadd nahi, ek rehnuma lakeer hai. Har insan ka jism caffeine par alag react karta hai. Kisi ko ek cup se dil tez dharakta mehsoos hota hai, kisi ko teen cup se bhi farq nahi parta.

3. Ek cup mein kitni caffeine?

FDA ke mutabiq 8 ounce coffee mein tehreeban 80 se 100 mg, aur 8 ounce chai (kali ya hari) mein tehreeban 30 se 50 mg caffeine hoti hai. Cola jaise 12 ounce ke drink mein tehreeban 30 se 40 mg.

Yaad rahe, yeh andaze hain. Chai ko jitni der dum dein ya jitni patti daalein, caffeine utni zyada nikalti hai. Dukaan ki kadak chai ghar ki halki chai se zyada ho sakti hai.

4. Hamal aur doodh pilane ke dauran

ACOG ki committee opinion ke mutabiq hamal mein 200 mg se kam caffeine rozana lena miscarriage ya samay se pehle paidaish ki bari wajah nahi lagti. Bachay ke qad aur wazan par caffeine ka asar abhi tak pakka nahi hai.

Kuch tehqeeqat is se bhi kam miqdar par fikar zahir karti hain, aur alag idaron ki had mukhtalif hai. Is liye hamal mein sab se behtar yeh hai ke apni gynaecologist se poochein aur chai ko kam se kam rakhein.

5. Bachon aur nojawanon ke liye

FDA ne bachon ke liye koi muqarrar miqdar tay nahi ki, magar American Academy of Pediatrics bachon aur nojawanon ko caffeine aur isi tarah ke stimulants se door rakhne ka mashwara deti hai. Energy drinks bachon ke liye bilkul achhi aadat nahi.

6. Zyada caffeine ki alamaat

Dil ka tez dharakna, ghabrahat, haath kaanpna, neend na aana aur pait kharab hona zyada caffeine ki aam nishaniyan hain. Agar yeh alamaat chai ke baad baar baar aayen to miqdar kam karein.

Chai ke saath cheeni ka bhi dhyan rakhein. Zyada cheeni wazan aur sugar ke liye alag masla hai, hamare chai-mein-cheeni waale mazmoon mein is par tafseel hai.

7. Aahista kam kaise karein?

Agar achanak chai chhod dein to sar dard, chidchidapan aur ghabrahat ho sakti hai. FDA bhi tadrijan kam karne ka mashwara deta hai. Misaal ke tor par aik hafte mein ek cup kam karein, ya aadhi chai aadha qehwa jaisi halki chai banayein.

Sone se kam az kam kuch ghante pehle chai band kar dein, taake raat ki neend kharab na ho.

8. Doctor se kab milein?

Agar chai ke baad dil ki dharkan be-tarteeb ho, seene mein dard ho, ya aap dil ki bimari, high blood pressure, ya acidity ke marz mein hain, to doctor se mashwara karein ke aap ke liye kitni caffeine theek hai. Hamal ya doodh pilane mein bhi apni doctor se poochein.

Hawalay (Sources)

  • FDA Consumer: Spilling the Beans: How Much Caffeine Is Too Much? (Drugs.com mirror)
  • ACOG Committee Opinion No. 462: Moderate caffeine consumption during pregnancy (PubMed)

Note: Yeh maloomat sirf aam agahi ke liye hai, ilaj ka mutabadal nahi. Koi bimari, hamal, ya musalsal alamaat hon to doctor se zaroor mashwara karein.

title: Smog Se Bachne Ke Tareeqay: Sahi Mask, Ghar Ki Hawa Aur Bachon Ki Hifazat
summary: Sardiyon mein smog bohat shehron mein aam hai. WHO aur CDC ki maloomat ke mutabiq smog ka sehat par asar, kaunsa mask kaam karta hai aur ghar ke andar hawa ko kaise behtar rakhein.

tableOfContents.title: 1. Smog sirf dhundh nahi, saans ka masla hai
3. Sab se behtar bachao: ghar ke andar
6. Hawa ki halat kaise check karein

content:
Key Takeaways

  • WHO ke mutabiq 2019 mein bahar ki hawa ki aaloodgi se dunya bhar mein tehreeban 42 lakh qabl az waqt mautein hui, aur in mein se tehreeban 68 fisad dil ki bimari aur stroke ki wajah se thin.
  • Smog mein sab se behtar bachao ghar ke andar rehna hai, khaas kar jab hawa ki halat bohat kharab ho.
  • Surgical mask ya kapde ka mask baareek zarron se poora bachao nahi deta. Bahar jana zaroori ho to tight fitting wala N95 ya P100 respirator behtar hai.
  • Bachon, buzurgon, haamla khawateen aur dama, dil ya diabetes ke mareezon ko zyada ehtiyat chahiye.

1. Smog sirf dhundh nahi, saans ka masla hai

Sardiyon mein subah ya shaam ko jab hawa bhaari aur aankhein jalti lagti hain, to yeh smog hota hai. Is mein bohat baareek zarre hote hain jinhein PM2.5 kaha jata hai. Yeh itne chhote hote hain ke saans ke raaste phephron tak pohanch sakte hain.

WHO ke mutabiq baareek zarron ki aaloodgi dil aur saans ki bimariyon aur cancer ka sabab ban sakti hai. WHO ka andaza hai ke 2019 mein bahar ki hawa ki aaloodgi se dunya bhar mein tehreeban 42 lakh qabl az waqt mautein hui, aur us saal dunya ki tehreeban 99 fisad aabadi aisi jagah rehti thi jahan WHO ki hawa ke maiyaar poore nahi hote.

2. Kin ko zyada khatra hai

CDC ke mutabiq bache, dama, COPD, dil ki bimari, diabetes ya gurde ki purani bimari wale log aur haamla khawateen dhuein ya aaloodgi se zyada mutasir ho sakte hain. Agar aap in mein se hain to smog ke dinon mein zyada ehtiyat karein.

Nai ya bigarti hui alamaat jaise khansi, saans phoolna, seene mein tangi ya sar dard par tawajjoh dein aur zaroorat ho to doctor se milein.

3. Sab se behtar bachao: ghar ke andar

CDC ke mutabiq jab dhuan ya aaloodgi zyada ho to ghar ke andar rehna sab se behtar hifazat hai. Zaroori na ho to subah sawere ki sair, bachon ka bahar khelna aur zyada mushaqqat wali warzish smog ke dinon mein kuch din ke liye roak dein.

Agar mumkin ho to ghar ke ek kamre ko "saaf kamra" bana lein jahan khirkiyan aur darwaze kam hon, aur use band rakhein. Mombati, agarbatti, lakri ya kooray ko jalane, ghar ke andar cigarette peene aur jhaadu ki jagah geele kapde se safai se parhez karein, kyunke yeh andar ki hawa bhi kharab karte hain.

4. Mask: kaunsa kaam karta hai

Aam surgical mask ya kapde ka mask baareek zarron ko poori tarah nahi rokte. US ke AirNow ke fact sheets bhi kehte hain ke aise masks se bachna chahiye jo sahi hifazat nahi dete. Agar bahar jana zaroori ho to NIOSH se manzoor N95 ya P100 respirator sab se zyada hifazat deta hai, bashart woh chehre par tight baithe.

Daarhi ya khula gap fit ko kharab kar deta hai. Aur respirator bachon ke size mein nahi aate, is liye chhote bachon ke liye ghar ke andar rehna aur bahar jaane ke waqt ko kam karna zyada ahem hai.

5. Ghar ki hawa behtar karein

CDC aur AirNow ke mutabiq ek portable air cleaner (HEPA) band kamre mein hawa ko saaf rakhne mein madad karta hai. Ozone paida karne wale air cleaner se bachein. Agar ghar mein central AC hai to MERV 13 ya us se behtar filter istemal karein, agar system sambhal sake.

Ghar mein air cleaner na ho to bhi kam az kam khirkiyan aur darwaze smog ke dinon mein band rakhein, aur hawa ke saaf waqt mein thori der ke liye kamra hawadaar karein. DIY box fan filter ko akela chalta na chhorein, CDC isse mana karta hai.

6. Hawa ki halat kaise check karein

Apne shehar ki hawa ki halat mausam ya air quality ki app ya kisi mustanad sarkari zariye se dekhein. Jab nateeja kharab ho to bahar ka kaam, waalking aur bachon ka khel ghar ke andar la kar rakhein.

7. Doctor se kab milein?

Agar saans phoolne lage, seene mein dard ho, khansi na rukey, ya dama/dil ke mareez ki dawa ke bawajood takleef barh jaye to doctor se rujoo karein. Seene mein tez dard, behoshi ya saans lene mein shadeed mushkil par fori emergency mein jayein.

Yeh article umoomi maloomat ke liye hai aur ilaaj ka mutabadal nahi.

title: Roz Anda Khana Theek Hai? Cholesterol Aur Dil Ke Hawale Se Sach
summary: Anda sasta aur ghar ka aam nashta hai, magar cholesterol ka darr bhi hai. American Heart Association aur Harvard Health ke mutabiq kitne anday theek hain aur kis ko ehtiyat chahiye.

tableOfContents.title: 2. Anday mein cholesterol hai, to masla kya hai?
5. Anday ke saath kya khate hain, woh zyada ahem hai

content:
Key Takeaways

  • American Heart Association ke mutabiq sehatmand log dil ke liye behtar khane ke andaaz ke andar rozana ek poora anda shamil kar sakte hain.
  • Anday ki zardi mein cholesterol hota hai, magar aksar logon ke khoon ke cholesterol par asal asar saturated fat (ghee, charbi wala gosht, full-fat dairy) ka hota hai.
  • Jin logon ko high cholesterol, diabetes ya dil ki bimari ho unhein Harvard Health ke mutabiq hafte mein zyada se zyada do anday ka mashwara diya jata hai, aur apne doctor se poochna chahiye.
  • Anday ke saath kya khaya jata hai (paratha, ghee, seekh/qeema) aksar anday se zyada ahem hota hai.

1. Anday par itna shak kyun?

Hamare ghar mein anday ka nashta aam hai: fry, boiled, omelette ya paratha ke saath. Magar kai saal tak sunte rahe ke anday se cholesterol barh jata hai aur dil ko nuqsan hota hai. Phir kabhi sunte hain ke anday bilkul theek hain. Sach yeh hai ke sehat ke mashwaray waqt ke saath tehqeeq ke saath badalte rehte hain.

Is article mein hum sirf wohi baatein likh rahe hain jo American Heart Association (AHA) aur Harvard Health jaise idaaron ne kahi hain, aur jahan unka mashwara alag hai wahan woh bhi bata dete hain.

2. Anday mein cholesterol hai, to masla kya hai?

Anday ki zardi mein cholesterol hota hai, yeh sach hai. Magar Harvard Health ke mutabiq khane mein maujood cholesterol aksar logon ke khoon ke cholesterol ko utna nahi barhata jitna pehle samjha jata tha.

Un ke mutabiq khoon ke cholesterol par zyada asar saturated fat ka hota hai, jo charbi wale gosht aur full-fat dairy se milta hai. Yani masla sirf anday ka nahi, poori plate ka hai.

3. AHA kya kehta hai?

AHA ki science advisory ke mutabiq sehatmand log dil ke liye behtar khane ke andaaz ke andar rozana ek poora anda (ya uske barabar) shamil kar sakte hain. AHA ke mutabiq anday ki safedi bhi isi hisaab mein ginti ja sakti hai.

AHA ki web summary mein yeh bhi likha gaya hai ke buzurg log jinka cholesterol theek ho, woh ek din mein do anday tak le sakte hain. Magar jin logon ko cholesterol ki bimari (dyslipidemia), diabetes ya dil ki nakami ka khatra ho, unke liye AHA ehtiyat ka mashwara deta hai.

4. Jin logon ko ehtiyat chahiye

Harvard Health ka mashwara zyada sakht hai: jin ko high blood cholesterol, diabetes ya dil ki bimari ho, unke liye hafte mein zyada se zyada do anday. Dono idaaron ki baatein ek hi disha mein hain: agar aap ko yeh masail hain to apne doctor ya dietitian se poochein ke aap ke liye kitne anday theek hain.

Kuch log khane ke cholesterol par zyada hassas hote hain. Isliye agar family mein cholesterol ya dil ki bimari aam hai, to apne lipid profile test ke nateeje ke mutabiq faisla karein, sirf internet ya rishtedaron ki raaye par nahi.

5. Anday ke saath kya khate hain, woh zyada ahem hai

Boiled ya kam tel mein bana omelette, saath mein sabziyan aur sabut gandum ki roti, dil ke liye achha andaaz hai. Isi anday ko desi ghee mein tal kar, paratha, aur saath mein seekh kabab ya qeema khayein to saturated fat kaafi barh jata hai.

Asaan tabdeeliyan: fry ki jagah boil ya poach, ghee ki matra kam, paratha ki jagah roti, aur anday mein pyaz, tamatar, palak jaise ajzaa daal dena.

6. Anday ke aur faiday

Anday protein aur kai ghizai ajzaa ka sasta zariya hai, is liye jin gharon mein gosht mehnga hai wahan yeh ek ahem khuraak ho sakta hai. Magar yeh koi "super food" nahi, aur sirf anday khane se wazan, cholesterol ya sehat ka masla hal nahi hota.

7. Doctor se kab milein?

Agar aap ko pehle se high cholesterol, diabetes ya dil ki bimari hai, ya family mein kam umar mein dil ka daura aam hai, to anday ki matra doctor se pooch kar tay karein. Agar kabhi anday khane ke baad hont, chehra sooj jayein, saans mein takleef ho ya jild par daane aa jayein to yeh allergy ki alamaat ho sakti hain; fori doctor se milein.

Yeh article umoomi maloomat ke liye hai, ilaaj ya diet plan ka mutabadal nahi.

  • American Heart Association: Dietary Cholesterol and Cardiovascular Risk (science advisory, Circulation 2020)
  • Harvard Health: Unscrambling the message on eggs

title: Sardiyon Mein Khushk Jild Se Bachne Ke Asaan Tareeqay
summary: Sardi aate hi jild khushk aur khujli wali ho jati hai. Dermatologists ki tajaweez: nahane ka tareeqa, moisturizer ka sahi waqt, aur kab skin specialist ko dikhana chahiye.

tableOfContents.title: 1. Sardi mein jild itni khushk kyun ho jati hai?

content:
Key Takeaways

  • AAD ke mutabiq nahane ka waqt 5 se 10 minute rakhein aur pani garam nahi, warm rakhein.
  • Moisturizer jild ke geele rehte hi, nahane aur haath dhone ke baad lagayein; lotion ke bajaye cream ya ointment behtar hai.
  • Khushbu wale aur deodorant soap se bachein, gentle fragrance-free cleanser lein.
  • Agar tamam koshish ke baad bhi khushki, khujli ya sooj na jaye to dermatologist se milein.

1. Sardi mein jild itni khushk kyun ho jati hai?

Thandi aur khushk hawa jild ki upari tah se nami kheench leti hai. Upar se hum garam pani se nahate hain, heater ya angethi ke qareeb baithte hain, aur room ki hawa mazeed khushk ho jati hai. Natija: jild kheenchi hui, khujli wali aur kabhi kabhi phati hui lagti hai.

Hathon, pindliyon, kohniyon aur honton par yeh sab se pehle nazar aata hai.

2. Nahane ka tareeqa badlein

American Academy of Dermatology (AAD) ke mutabiq nahana 5 se 10 minute tak rakhein aur warm pani istemal karein, bohat garam nahi. Nahate waqt bathroom ka darwaza band rakhein.

Gentle cleanser ko sirf wahan istemal karein jahan zaroorat ho, jaise baghal aur groin, aur ghana jhaag banane ki koshish na karein. Nahane ke baad tauliye se jild ko ragarne ke bajaye thapthapa kar khushk karein.

3. Moisturizer: kab aur kaun sa

AAD ke mutabiq moisturizer din mein kai baar lagayein: nahane ke baad jab jild abhi geeli ho, haath dhone ke baad, aur jab bhi jild khushk lage. Halke haath se massage kar ke jazb hone dein.

Lotion ke muqable mein cream ya ointment behtar tarjeeh hai. Ajzaa mein glycerin, petrolatum, shea butter, dimethicone ya hyaluronic acid jaisi cheezein dekhi ja sakti hain. Honton ke liye lip balm ya petroleum jelly kaam aati hai.

Saath hi fragrance-free products chunein. AAD yeh bhi kehta hai ke jis product par unscented likha ho us mein bhi aisay ajzaa ho sakte hain jo khushk jild ko tang karein.

4. Mahol aur libaas ka khayal

Agar room ki hawa bohat khushk ho to humidifier madadgar ho sakta hai; AAD ke mutabiq raat ko bedroom mein portable unit chalayi ja sakti hai, magar usay saaf rakhna zaroori hai warna us mein fungus lag sakta hai.

Libaas mein dhila cotton behtar rehta hai. Ooni ya polyester kapda seedha jild se lagne se khujli barh sakti hai, is liye neeche cotton ki tah pehan lein. Bartan dhote waqt ya thandi hawa mein bahar jate waqt dastane pehnain.

5. Sardi mein bhi sunscreen

Dhoop sardi mein bhi jild ko nuqsan pohanchati hai. AAD broad-spectrum, water-resistant sunscreen SPF 30 ya us se zyada ka mashwara deta hai, aur saaya dhoondne ya dhoop se bachane wale libaas pehnne ka bhi.

6. Doctor (dermatologist) se kab milein?

AAD ke mutabiq agar mazkoora tareeqay azmane ke bawajood khushki barqarar rahe, ya kisi product se jalan, chubhan ya laali ho, to dermatologist se milein. Kabhi khushk jild ke peeche eczema (atopic dermatitis), psoriasis ya gurde ki bimari bhi ho sakti hai, aur ilaaj na karne se masla barh sakta hai.

Anti-itch cream lagane se pehle bhi dermatologist se poochein. Yeh article umoomi maloomat ke liye hai, ilaaj ka mutabadal nahi.

Hawalay (Sources)

  • American Academy of Dermatology: Dermatologists' top tips for relieving dry skin
  • American Academy of Dermatology: Dry skin remedies for darker skin tones

Note: Yeh maloomat sirf aam agahi ke liye hai, ilaj ka mutabadal nahi. Koi bimari, hamal, ya musalsal alamaat hon to doctor se zaroor mashwara karein.
metaDescription: Sardi aate hi jild khushk aur khujli wali ho jati hai. Dermatologists ki tajaweez: nahane ka tareeqa, moisturizer ka sahi waqt, aur kab skin specialist ko dikhana chahiye.

title: Ajwain Aur Saunf Hazme Ke Liye: Kitna Sach, Kitni Ehtiyat
summary: Khane ke baad ajwain ya saunf chabana purani aadat hai. Is par insani research kitni hai, kis ko ehtiyat karni chahiye aur kab doctor ke paas jana chahiye.

tableOfContents.title: 1. Khane ke baad ek chutki, yeh aadat kahan se aayi?
3. Ajwain: asar ka saboot kitna hai
4. Kin logon ko ehtiyat karni chahiye
5. Hazma behtar karne ke asaan tareeqay jo pehle azmayein

content:
Key Takeaways

  • Saunf aur ajwain hamare ghar ki purani aadat hain, magar un ke hazme par asar ka insani (human) evidence abhi mehdood hai.
  • Khane mein istemal hone wali miqdar aam tor par mehfooz samjhi jati hai; bari miqdar ya roz ka concentrated kaadha behtar nahi.
  • Hamal ya doodh pilane ke dinon mein, aur choti umar ke bachon ko, khud se kaadha na dein; pehle doctor se poochein.
  • Bar bar pait dard, wazan girna ya khoon ki ulti jaisi alamaat ka hal totke se nahi, doctor se karwayein.

1. Khane ke baad ek chutki, yeh aadat kahan se aayi?

Dawat ke baad saunf aur mishri, ya bhaari khane ke baad ajwain ka phanka: yeh hamare gharon ki purani riwayat hai. Dadi nani kehti thin ke is se hazma theek rehta hai. Sawal yeh hai ke science is baare mein kya kehti hai?

Sach yeh hai ke dono cheezein sadiyon se dawai ke taur par istemal hoti rahi hain, magar riwayat aur saboot ek cheez nahi. Is article mein hum wahi likh rahe hain jo review articles mein nazar aaya, aur jahan evidence kam hai wahan saaf keh rahe hain.

2. Saunf: riwayat aur research

Saunf ko traditional medicine mein pait ki gas aur bhaari-pan ke liye istemal kiya jata raha hai. Lab aur janwaron par kiye gaye mutalo mein is ke ajzaa ka hazme ke nizam ke muscles par asar dekha gaya hai.

Magar insanon par kiye gaye barey aur mazboot trials abhi kam hain. Is liye yeh kehna ke saunf har kisi ka hazma theek kar deti hai, sahi nahi hoga. Hamari rai mein khane ke baad thori si saunf chabana aik sasta aur aam tor par bay-zarar tareeqa hai, magar isay ilaaj na samjhein.

3. Ajwain: asar ka saboot kitna hai

Ajwain ke baare mein bhi zyada tar tehqeeq lab ya janwaron par hui hai, jahan hazme ke rasoon par asar dekha gaya. Insani trials mein mazboot saboot ki kami hai.

Isliye ajwain ko khane mein shamil karna, jaise parathe ya daal mein, bilkul theek hai. Lekin ajwain se acidity ya chronic gas khatam jaisay daawon ko mazboot saboot haasil nahi.

4. Kin logon ko ehtiyat karni chahiye

Khane mein istemal hone wali miqdar aur concentrated kaadha ya baar baar ki bari miqdar mein farq hai. Saunf mein estragole naam ka ek mada hota hai jis par tehqeeqat mein bahes hui hai; kuch tehqeeqat ke mutabiq aam khane ki miqdar mein khatra kam samjha gaya, magar bachon ke liye zyada ehtiyat ka mashwara diya gaya.

Isliye choti umar ke bachon ko saunf ka kaadha khud se mat dein, aur hamal ya doodh pilane ke dinon mein ajwain ya saunf ki bari miqdar se pehle doctor se poochein. Kisi ko in mein se kisi se allergy ho to bilkul istemal na karein.

Agar aap koi dawa le rahi hain, khaaskar khoon patla karne ya diabetes ki, to jadi-booti kaadhon ki rozana bari miqdar se pehle apne doctor ya pharmacist se pooch lein.

5. Hazma behtar karne ke asaan tareeqay jo pehle azmayein

Hazme ki shikayat ki aksar wajah khane ka andaz hota hai: bohat tezi se khana, raat ko dair se aur bohat bhaari khana, aur khane ke foran baad letna.

Aahista aur achi tarah chaba kar khayein, raat ka khana sone se kuch ghante pehle khayein, aur khane ke baad chand minute chalein. Pani aur reshay wali cheezein (daal, sabziyan, phal) qabz se bachane mein madadgar hain.

Aap chahein to saath mein thori si saunf ya ajwain bhi le sakti hain. Yeh in aadaton ka badal nahi, bas inka sahara hai.

6. Doctor se kab milein?

Agar pait dard kai din se zyada rahe, nigalne mein dushwari ho, wazan bila wajah girta jaye, ulti mein khoon ho, kaale rang ka pakhana aaye, ya barhi umar mein hazme ki nayi shikayat shuru hui ho to totke mein waqt zaya na karein.

Hamal, doodh pilana, jigar ya gurde ki bimari, ya koi regular dawa ho to bhi kaadha shuru karne se pehle doctor se mashwara karein. Yeh article maloomat ke liye hai, ilaaj ya tashkhees ka badal nahi.

  • Foeniculum vulgare Mill: A Review of Its Botany, Phytochemistry, Pharmacology, Contemporary Application, and Toxicology (PMC)
  • Can Estragole in Fennel Seed Decoctions Really Be Considered a Danger for Human Health? A Fennel Safety Update (PMC)
  • Chemical analysis of estragole in fennel based teas and associated safety assessment (PubMed)
  • Cardiovascular Effects, Phytochemistry, Drug Interactions, and Safety Profile of Fennel: A Comprehensive Review (PMC)

title: Chai Mein Cheeni Kitni Theek Hai: Roz Ki Meethi Ka Hisaab
summary: Roz ki chai, sharbat aur meethe mein kitni cheeni ho jati hai? WHO aur NHS ke hawale se free sugar ki had aur chai ki cheeni aahista kam karne ke asaan tareeqay.

tableOfContents.title: 4. Zyada cheeni se kya hota hai
5. Chai ki cheeni kam kaise karein

content:
Key Takeaways

  • WHO ke mutabiq free sugars rozana ki energy ke 10 fisad se kam rakhni chahiye; 5 fisad se kam mazeed faida de sakta hai.
  • 5 fisad takreeban 25 gram yani 6 chamach cheeni ke barabar hai.
  • NHS ke mutabiq free sugars mein shahad, sharbat aur fruit juice bhi shamil hain, magar phal aur doodh ki qudrati cheeni nahi.
  • Zyada cheeni se extra calories milti hain aur wazan barh sakta hai.
  • Chai ki cheeni achanak nahi, aahista aahista kam karna asaan hai.

1. Chai aur cheeni ka rishta

Hamare ghar mein chai din mein 2 se 4 baar banti hai aur har pyaali mein cheeni ke chamach. Hum us ko "khana" nahi ginte, is liye hisaab mein bhi nahi aati. Magar chamach chamach karke din bhar mein kaafi cheeni jama ho sakti hai.

Is article mein hum dekhte hain ke sehat ke idaray kitni cheeni ki had batate hain, aur chai ko bina mushkil ke kaise halka kiya ja sakta hai.

2. Free sugars kya hoti hain

WHO ke mutabiq free sugars woh hain jo khane peene ki cheezon mein company, bawarchi ya aap khud daalte hain. Is mein shahad, syrup, fruit juice aur juice concentrate ki cheeni bhi shamil hai. Taaza phal, sabziyon aur doodh ki qudrati cheeni is mein nahi ginti jati.

NHS bhi yehi kehta hai: biscuit, chocolate, meethe dahi, nashta cereal, soft drinks, shahad aur unsweetened juice ki cheeni free sugars mein aati hai.

3. Had kitni hai

WHO adults aur bachon dono ke liye free sugars ko rozana ki kul energy ke 10 fisad se kam rakhne ka mashwara deta hai, aur 5 fisad se kam, yani takreeban 25 gram ya 6 chamach, mazeed faida de sakta hai. WHO is doosri sifarish ko "conditional" kehta hai kyunke is ke saboot nisbatan kam hain.

NHS (UK) ke mutabiq adults ke liye free sugars ki rozana had 30 gram hai, jo takreeban 7 cheeni ke cubes ke barabar hai. Bachon ke liye umar ke hisaab se kam: 7 se 10 saal ke liye 24 gram, 4 se 6 saal ke liye 19 gram.

Misal ke tor par agar chai mein 2 chamach cheeni daal kar din mein 3 pyaaliyan peeyen, to bina mithai ya sharbat ke bhi 6 chamach tak pohanch sakte hain. Yeh sirf ek andaza hai; chamach ka size aur dher mukhtalif hota hai.

4. Zyada cheeni se kya hota hai

NHS ke mutabiq zyada cheeni se extra calories milti hain jo wazan barha sakti hain, aur zyada wazan dil ki bimari, kuch cancers aur type 2 diabetes ka khatra barhata hai. NHS cheeni ko dant kharab hone ki ahem wajohat mein se ek bhi batata hai.

WHO ke review ke mutabiq jin adults ki cheeni kam thi unka wazan kam raha, aur zyada cheeni wazan barhne se jorhi gayi. Meethe mashroobat zyada peene wale bachon mein motapay ka imkan zyada paya gaya.

5. Chai ki cheeni kam kaise karein

NHS ka seedha mashwara hai: agar chai ya coffee mein cheeni lete hain to isay aahista aahista kam karein, yahan tak ke band ho jaye. Matlab ek dam se phiki chai ki jaga hafton mein thora thora kam karna.

Asaan tareeqay: pehle har pyaali se aadha chamach kam karein; chhota mug rakhein; chai ke saath biscuit ya rusk ki jaga bhuna chana ya ek mutthi badam jaise bina cheeni ke snack rakhein; sharbat ya cold drink ko roz ki aadat se hata kar kabhi kabhi ka muqam dein.

Dant ke liye NHS meethi cheezen mealtime tak mehdood rakhne aur juice ko din mein 150 ml tak rakhne ka kehta hai.

6. Wazan aur cheeni ka sach

Sirf cheeni chhorne se wazan kam hone ka wada nahi kiya ja sakta. Wazan kul calories, khane ki miqdar aur harkat par mabni hai. Magar cheeni wali cheezein aksar calories de deti hain, is liye unhein kam karna ek asaan pehla qadam hai.

Ek aasan tareeqa: do hafte tak rozana ki meethi cheezein likh lein, jaise chai, biscuit, sharbat, meethay. Is se andaza ho jata hai ke cheeni kahan se aa rahi hai.

7. Doctor se kab milein

Agar aap ko diabetes hai ya shak hai (bohat pyaas, baar baar peshab, thakan, wazan mein ghair mamooli kami), to cheeni ki had apne doctor ya dietitian se tay karwayein. Hamal mein ya kisi bimari mein khuraak badalni ho to bhi mashwara lein.

Yeh maloomat aam agahi ke liye hai aur doctor ke mashware ka mutabadal nahi.

title: Dil Ka Daura: Alamaat Pehchanein Aur Foran Kya Karein
summary: Heart attack ki alamaat, khawateen mein kam wazeh nishaniyan, emergency mein kya karna hai aur bachao ke tareeqay. NHS aur CDC ke hawale se.

tableOfContents.title: 1. Dil ka daura hota kya hai
4. Heart attack aur cardiac arrest ka farq
5. Alamaat hon to foran kya karein

content:
Key Takeaways

  • CDC ke mutabiq heart attack tab hota hai jab dil ke muscle ke ek hisse ko kafi khoon nahi milta.
  • Seene ke beech ya baayen taraf takleef jo chand minute se zyada rahe ya ja kar wapas aaye, ahem nishani hai.
  • Dard bazu, jabray, gardan ya peeth tak ja sakta hai; saans phoolna, thanda paseena aur chakkar bhi aam hain.
  • CDC ke mutabiq khawateen mein ghair mamooli thakan aur matli jaisi kam wazeh alamaat zyada ho sakti hain.
  • Alamaat hon to foran emergency number par call karein; NHS ke mutabiq khud gaari chala kar hospital na jayein.

1. Dil ka daura hota kya hai

CDC ke mutabiq heart attack us waqt hota hai jab dil ke muscle ke kisi hisse ko kafi khoon nahi milta. Khoon ke saath oxygen bhi nahi pohanchta, is liye jitni der guzarti hai dil ko nuqsan barhta hai.

Isi wajah se jaldi aspatal pohanchna sab se ahem hai. CDC kehta hai ke emergency room mein jaldi pohanchne se dil ke muscle ko hone wala nuqsan kam kiya ja sakta hai.

2. Sab se aam alamaat

Sab se aam nishani seene mein takleef hai. CDC ke mutabiq yeh takleef seene ke beech ya baayen taraf hoti hai, chand minute se zyada rehti hai, ya ghayab ho kar dobara aa jati hai. NHS ke mutabiq yeh dard kasne wala ya dabane wala mehsoos ho sakta hai, aur bazu, gardan ya jabray tak phail sakta hai.

Doosri alamaat mein saans phoolna, kamzori, chakkar ya behoshi jaisa lagna, thanda paseena, matli ya ulti shamil hain. CDC ke mutabiq kabhi saans ki takleef seene ke dard se pehle bhi shuru ho sakti hai.

NHS yeh bhi batata hai ke kuch logon ko badhazmi jaisa ehsaas hota hai, yani seene mein jalan ya pait bhara bhara lagna. Is liye har "gas" ko ghar ke totkon se tal dena theek nahi, khaas kar jab saath mein paseena, saans ki tangi ya dard phailna ho.

3. Khawateen mein nishaniyan

CDC ke mutabiq khawateen mein kam wazeh alamaat zyada hoti hain, jaise ghair mamooli ya wajah ke baghair thakan, aur matli ya ulti. Ghar mein aksar khawateen apni takleef ko "kaam ki thakan" keh kar nazar andaz kar deti hain.

Agar thakan aam se bilkul alag ho, achanak aaye, ya saath mein saans, paseena ya seene ki beqarari ho to isay halka na lein.

4. Heart attack aur cardiac arrest ka farq

NHS ke mutabiq heart attack mein dil ko khoon ka rasta band hota hai aur insaan aam tor par hosh mein hota hai. Cardiac arrest mein dil achanak dhadakna band kar deta hai, insaan behosh ho jata hai aur ilaaj mukhtalif hota hai. Dono emergency hain.

5. Alamaat hon to foran kya karein

CDC ke mutabiq apne ya kisi aur mein alamaat dekhein to fori tor par emergency number par call karein. Apne shehar ka emergency ya ambulance number pehle se likh kar rakhein.

NHS ke mutabiq khud gaari chala kar hospital na jayein; call lene wala aap ko hidayat de ga. Intezar ke dauran araam se baith jayein, aur NHS ke mutabiq agar aap ke paas aspirin ho aur us se allergy na ho to 300 mg li ja sakti hai. Kisi aur ko aspirin dene se pehle allergy zaroor poochein. Doctor ne pehle se koi dawai batai ho to us ke mutabiq chalein.

Agar insaan behosh ho jaye aur saans na le raha ho to NHS ke mutabiq CPR shuru karein. Ghar ya mohalle mein kisi na kisi ko CPR sikhna bohat kaam aa sakta hai.

6. Khatre ki wajohat aur bachao

CDC ke mutabiq heart attack ke ahem khatray mein high blood pressure, high cholesterol aur sigrat nosh hain. Umar aur khandani tareekh badli nahi ja sakti, magar baqi khatray kam kiye ja sakte hain.

Asaan qadam: blood pressure aur cholesterol ki jaanch karwana, sigrat chhodna, namak aur tali hui cheezen kam karna aur roz chalna. NHS diabetes ko bhi khatre ki wajah mein ginta hai, is liye sugar ka khayal rakhein.

7. Doctor se kab milein

Seene mein dabao, saans phoolna, paseena ya dard jo bazu, gardan ya jabray tak jaye to doctor ka intezar na karein, foran emergency bulayein. NHS ke mutabiq seene ka dard saath matli ya dharkan ki be-tarteebi ho to bhi fori mashwara lein.

Agar aap ko khatray wali wajohat hain ya khandan mein kam umar mein dil ki bimari rahi hai to bina alamaat ke bhi doctor se checkup karwayein.

Yeh maloomat aam agahi ke liye hai aur doctor ke mashware ka mutabadal nahi.

Hawalay (Sources)

  • CDC: About Heart Attack
  • NHS: Heart attack

Note: Yeh maloomat sirf aam agahi ke liye hai, ilaj ka mutabadal nahi. Koi bimari, hamal, ya musalsal alamaat hon to doctor se zaroor mashwara karein.

title: Sardi Zukam Ke Gharelu Totkay: Vitamin C, Lehsan, Shahad Aur Zinc Mein Kya Kaam Karta Hai
summary: Vitamin C, lehsan, shahad, zinc aur namak ke gharare par NCCIH aur NHS kya kehte hain. Kis ka saboot kamzor hai aur kis mein ehtiyaat zaroori hai.

tableOfContents.title: 1. Zukam ke totkay itne mashhoor kyun hain
4. Shahad aur limoo ka garam mashroob
6. Namak ke paani ke gharare aur naak ki safai

content:
Key Takeaways

  • NCCIH ke mutabiq aam logon mein vitamin C zukam ko rokta nahi aur sirf thora sa mukhtasar karta hai.
  • Lehsan aur echinacea ke baare mein saboot nakafi ya mila-jula hai.
  • Shahad par chhoti tehqeeq bachon ki raat ki khansi mein faida batati hai, magar ek saal se chhote bachay ko kabhi na dein.
  • Naak mein lagane wale zinc gel ya swab ka NCCIH mashwara nahi deta, soongne ki salahiyat jane ka khatra hai.
  • Koi bhi totka antibiotic ka badal nahi, aur zukam virus se hota hai jis par antibiotic kaam nahi karti.

1. Zukam ke totkay itne mashhoor kyun hain

Sardi shuru hote hi ghar mein kehwa, kaali mirch wala doodh, lehsan aur narangi ka ras tayar hone lagta hai. Har ghar ka apna nuskha hai. Sawal yeh hai ke in mein se kitne ka saboot maujood hai, aur kahan paisa ya ummeed zaya ho rahi hai.

Is article mein hum NIH ke NCCIH aur NHS ki rahnumai dekhte hain. Pehle ek asal baat: zukam aksar khud theek hone wali infection hai, is liye koi bhi totka zyada se zyada takleef kam kar sakta hai, bimari ko "khatam" nahi karta.

2. Vitamin C: kitna sach

NCCIH ke mutabiq aam logon mein vitamin C zukam ko rokta nahi aur ise sirf thora sa mukhtasar karta hai. Alamaat shuru hone ke baad lene se faida nazar nahi aata. Sirf un logon mein jo chhote waqt ke liye intehai jismani dabao mein hotay hain, jaise marathon daurne wale, tehqeeq mein zukam ki tadad kam dekhi gayi.

NHS bhi kehta hai ke vitamin C, echinacea ya lehsan ke supplements zukam rokne ya jaldi theek karne ke liye bohat kam saboot rakhte hain. Zyada khuraak se dast, matli aur pait mein marore ho sakta hai. Narangi, malta, amrood aur kinnow ko khane ka hissa bana lena kafi behtar aur sasta hai.

3. Lehsan aur echinacea

NCCIH ke mutabiq 2014 ke ek jaiza mein lehsan ke zukam rokne ya alamaat kam karne ke liye kafi saboot nahi mila. Lehsan se munh aur jism se boo aa sakti hai, aur yeh khoon patla karne wali dawaon se takra sakta hai.

Echinacea ke baare mein bhi NCCIH ka nateeja nakafi hai. Mukhtalif products mein paudhe ki qisam, hissa aur banawat bohat mukhtalif hoti hai, is liye ek product ke nataij doosre par lagoo nahi hotay. Allergy ho sakti hai.

Khane mein lehsan ka istemal bilkul theek hai, magar usay ilaaj samajh kar supplements mat khareedein.

4. Shahad aur limoo ka garam mashroob

NHS zukam mein aadha limoo garam paani mein nichod kar 1 se 2 chamach shahad milane ka zikar karta hai. NCCIH ke mutabiq chhoti tehqeeq bataati hai ke shahad bachon mein raat ki khansi kam kar sakta hai, magar saboot limited hai.

Ek saal se kam umar ke bachon ko shahad kabhi na dein kyunke infant botulism ka khatra hota hai. Bohat garam cheez chhote bachon ko na dein. Diabetes wale afraad shahad aur meethe mashroob ki miqdar par apne doctor se poochein.

5. Zinc: umeed bhi, ehtiyaat bhi

NCCIH ke mutabiq munh se lene wale zinc (lozenges, tablets, syrup) ke reviews ne bataya ke yeh baaligh logon mein zukam ka waqt kam kar sakte hain, is liye iska darja "promising" hai. Munh ka zaiqa kharab hona aur matli iske aam asraat hain. Lambay arsay tak zyada khuraak jism mein copper kam kar sakti hai.

Naak mein lagane wale zinc gel aur swab ke baare mein NCCIH saaf kehta hai ke inka mashwara nahi, kyunke soongne ki salahiyat hamesha ke liye ja sakti hai. FDA ne 2009 mein kuch products ke baare mein khabardar kiya tha. Zinc lene se pehle doctor ya pharmacist se poochna behtar hai, khaaskar agar aap pehle se koi dawai lete hon.

6. Namak ke paani ke gharare aur naak ki safai

NHS band galay ke liye namak ke paani ke gharare (bachon ke liye nahi) aur band naak ke liye bharaf lene ko ghar ke aaram ka tareeqa batata hai. NCCIH ke mutabiq naak dhone (saline rinse) par tehqeeq abhi chhoti hai. Agar naak dhoyen to sirf ubla kar thanda kiya hua ya filter kiya hua paani istemal karein, nal ka seedha paani nahi. NCCIH aur FDA is par khaas ehtiyaat ka mashwara dete hain.

7. Aap ke liye amli nuskha

Aaram, neend aur paani sab se zyada kaam ki cheezen hain. Garam shorba, daal ka soup ya sada chai aap ko achha mehsoos karwa sakte hain, magar yeh bimari ko tez nahi karte. Haath dhona aur bimari mein ghar rehna doosron ko bachata hai.

Totka aazmate waqt apne aap se poochein: kya yeh sasta aur mehfooz hai? Kya mere paas koi dawai ya bimari hai jis se takra sakta hai? Kya main ise doctor ke ilaaj ki jagah le raha hoon? Agar aakhri jawab "nahi" hai to mukhtasar aaram ke liye aazma saktay hain.

8. Doctor se kab milein

NHS ke mutabiq zukam mein tez bukhar 3 din se zyada rahe, alamaat bigar jayen ya 10 din baad bhi behtar na hon, khansi 3 hafte se zyada chale, saans phoolay ya seene mein dard ho to doctor ko dikhayein. Bachon, hamla khawateen, buzurgon aur diabetes, dil, phephron ya gurde ki bimari wale logon ko zyada jald rabta karna chahiye.

Yeh maloomat aam agahi ke liye hai aur doctor ke mashware ka mutabadal nahi.

Hawalay (Sources)

  • NIH NCCIH: Colds, Flu, and Complementary Health Approaches
  • NHS: Common cold
  • NHS: Flu

Note: Yeh maloomat sirf aam agahi ke liye hai, ilaj ka mutabadal nahi. Koi bimari, hamal, ya musalsal alamaat hon to doctor se zaroor mashwara karein.

title: Zukam Aur Flu Mein Farq: Pehchan, Ghar Ki Dekh-Bhaal Aur Kab Doctor Se Milein
summary: Zukam aur flu ek jaisay lagte hain magar farq hai. NHS aur CDC ke hawalon se alamaat, ghar par kya karein aur kab doctor ko dikhayein.

tableOfContents.title: 1. Dono ek jaisay kyun lagte hain
5. Ghar par kya madad karta hai
7. Doosron ko bachane ke asaan tareeqay

content:
Key Takeaways

  • NHS ke mutabiq flu chand ghanton mein achanak shuru hota hai, jabke zukam aahista aahista barhta hai.
  • Zukam mein zyada tar naak aur galay par asar hota hai; flu mein jism dard, thakan aur tez bukhar aam hain.
  • Zukam aur flu dono virus se hotay hain, is liye antibiotics in mein kaam nahi karti.
  • CDC ke mutabiq roz marra kaam par wapas jane se pehle kam az kam 24 ghante bukhar ke baghair guzarna aur alamaat ka behtar hona zaroori hai.
  • Saans phoolna, seene mein dard ya 7 din baad bhi behtari na aana doctor ko dikhane ki wajah hai.

1. Dono ek jaisay kyun lagte hain

Sardiyon mein har doosra ghar chheenkon aur khansi se bhara hota hai. Aksar hum kehte hain "bas zukam hai", jabke kabhi kabhi woh flu hota hai. Dono saans ke raste ki infection hain aur dono virus se hoti hain, is liye shuru mein inhein alag karna mushkil lagta hai.

Farq pehchanna is liye faida mand hai ke flu mein aaram aur ehtiyaat ki zaroorat zyada hoti hai, aur kuch logon ke liye flu khatarnak bhi ho sakta hai.

2. Shuru kaise hota hai

NHS ke mutabiq flu bohat tez, kuch ghanton ke andar shuru ho jata hai. Aap subah theek hotay hain aur dopahar tak jism toot raha hota hai. Zukam is ke muqable mein aahista barhta hai, yani 1 se 2 din mein alamaat zahir hoti hain.

NHS ki zukam wali alag list mein yeh waqt 2 se 3 din tak bhi bataya gaya hai. Matlab zukam dheere dheere aata hai aur ek dam se pachhad nahi deta.

3. Alamaat ka farq

Zukam mein zyada tar naak band ya behti hui, chheenkein, galay mein kharash, awaz bhari hona aur khansi hoti hai. Kabhi halka bukhar ya jism dard bhi ho sakta hai.

Flu mein achanak tez bukhar, jism mein dard, shadeed thakan, khushk khansi, galay ka dard, sir dard, neend mein mushkil aur bhook kam hona shamil hain. NHS ke mutabiq flu mein aap itne thak sakte hain ke roz marra kaam bhi na kar saken, jabke zukam mein aam tor par aap chal phir lete hain.

Bachon mein kaan ka dard, aankhon ki jalan, gilti aur sust rehna bhi flu ki alamaat ho sakti hain.

4. Kitne din chalta hai

NHS ke mutabiq zukam mein aap aam tor par 1 se 2 hafton mein behtar mehsoos karne lagte hain, aur jab tak alamaat khatam na hon doosron ko lag sakta hai. Ghar ke hisaab se: bachay ka zukam ammi ko aur phir dadi ko lag jata hai, is liye alag bartan aur tauliye ka istemal samajhdari hai.

Flu ke baare mein NHS ka mashwara hai ke agar 7 din ke baad bhi alamaat behtar na hon to madad lein. NHS ke mutabiq flu shuru ke 5 din mein sab se zyada phailta hai.

5. Ghar par kya madad karta hai

NHS ke mutabiq aaram, neend aur khoob saara paani madad karte hain. Paani itna peeyen ke peshab ka rang halka peela ya saaf rahe. Bukhar aur dard ke liye NHS paracetamol ya ibuprofen ka zikar karta hai, magar khuraak packet par dekhein ya pharmacist se poochein.

Zukam ke liye NHS garam paani mein aadha limoo aur 1 se 2 chamach shahad ka mashroob, namak ke paani ke gharare (bachon ke liye nahi) aur band naak ke liye bharaf (steam) ka zikar karta hai. Ek saal se chhote bachay ko shahad kabhi na dein, aur bachon ko garam paani ke bartan se bharaf na lene dein.

Do dawaon mein paracetamol dobara shamil na ho, warna zyada khuraak ka khatra hota hai. 16 saal se kam umar ke bachon ko aspirin na dein.

6. Antibiotics kyun nahi

Zukam aur flu virus se hotay hain aur antibiotics sirf bacterial infection mein kaam karti hain. NHS saaf kehta hai ke doctor in dono ke liye antibiotics nahi likhte. Bina wajah antibiotics lene se asal masle mein faida nahi hota.

7. Doosron ko bachane ke asaan tareeqay

CDC ke mutabiq beemar logon se faasla rakhein, beemar hon to ghar rahein, khansi ya chheenk par munh aur naak dhaankein, haath baar baar dhoyen, aankhon, naak aur munh ko haath na lagayein, aur kamray mein taazi hawa aane dein.

CDC ke mutabiq normal kaam par wapas jane ke liye kam az kam 24 ghante tak bukhar na hona aur alamaat ka behtar hona zaroori hai, aur yeh bukhar ki dawai ke baghair hona chahiye. NHS ke mutabiq jarasim hathon aur sataho par 24 ghante tak zinda reh sakte hain.

Flu se bachao mein CDC saalana flu vaccine ko sab se pehla aur ahem qadam kehta hai. Aap ke liye kya munasib hai, apne doctor se poochein.

8. Doctor se kab milein

NHS ke mutabiq agar flu ki alamaat 7 din ke baad bhi behtar na hon, aap bohat beemar mehsoos karein, saans phoolay, ya aap zyada khatre wale group mein hon to jald doctor se rabta karein. Zyada khatre mein 65 saal se zyada umar ke log, hamla khawateen, aur diabetes ya dil, phephron, gurde, jigar ki bimari wale log shamil hain.

Seene mein achanak dard, saans mein shadeed mushkil ya khansi mein khoon aaye to foran emergency jayein. Zukam mein bukhar 3 din se zyada rahe, 10 din baad bhi behtari na ho, ya khansi 3 hafte se zyada chale to bhi doctor ko dikhayein.

Yeh maloomat aam agahi ke liye hai aur doctor ke mashware ka mutabadal nahi.

  • CDC: Healthy Habits to Prevent Flu

title: Haldi Ke Faiday: Doodh Aur Khane Mein Kitna Sach, Kitna Mubalagha
summary: Haldi aur curcumin ke bare mein NIH ka NCCIH kya kehta hai: kahan evidence hai, kahan nahi, supplements ke khatray aur khane mein istemal ka sahi andaaz.

tableOfContents.title: 2. NIH ka NCCIH kya kehta hai
3. Haldi wala doodh: kya yeh kaam karta hai
5. Hamal, doodh pilane wali maen aur dawaen

content:
Key Takeaways

  • NCCIH ke mutabiq haldi ya curcumin kisi bhi sehat ke maqsad ke liye faidemand hone ka pakka faisla karne ke liye abhi kaafi evidence nahi hai.
  • Ghutne ke osteoarthritis (dard aur akdan) mein shuruati evidence musbat hai, lekin behtar tehqeeq ki zaroorat hai.
  • Zyada taqatwar curcumin supplements se kuch logon mein jigar ko nuqsan ki khabrein aayi hain.
  • Khane mein haldi daalna aam tor par mehfooz hai. Hamal mein haldi ke supplements mehfooz nahi ho sakte.

1. Haldi hamare ghar ki pehchan

Daal, salan, chawal, aur sardiyon mein haldi wala doodh, haldi har ghar ke bawarchi khane ka hissa hai. Bohat se logon ko bachpan se yahi sikhaya gaya hai ke chot ya khansi ho to haldi doodh pi lo. Aaj social media par haldi ko har bimari ka hal bataya jata hai. Chaliye dekhte hain ke saaf-suthri science kya kehti hai.

Haldi ek paudhe ki jar (rhizome, zameen ke andar ka tana) hai. NCCIH ke mutabiq yeh khane aur zeenat ke maqsad ke liye istemal hoti rahi hai. Curcumin haldi ka ek jaza hai jis par sab se zyada tehqeeq hui hai.

2. NIH ka NCCIH kya kehta hai

NIH ke National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH) ke mutabiq abhi yeh kehne ke liye kaafi evidence nahi hai ke haldi ya curcumin kisi bhi sehat ke maqsad mein faidemand hai.

Ghutne ke osteoarthritis mein dard, akdan aur harkat ke bare mein shuruati nataij musbat hain, lekin NCCIH kehta hai ke behtar darje ki tehqeeq ki zaroorat hai. Fatty liver (NAFLD), ghutne ke dard par lagane wali curcumin, aur cancer ke ilaaj ke dauran moun ke zakhmon jaise masail mein bhi evidence abhi shuruati ya wazeh nahi hai.

Yani "haldi ilaaj hai" jaisi baat sach nahi, aur "haldi bekaar hai" bhi ghalat hogi. Sahi jumla hai: shayad kuch faida ho, magar abhi pakka nahi.

3. Haldi wala doodh: kya yeh kaam karta hai

Haldi wala doodh garam, tasalli bakhsh aur ghar ka purana nuskha hai. Is ka lutf apni jagah. Magar jo daawe aksar suney jate hain, jaise "andar ki chot theek", "sab sooja khatam" ya "immunity ka ilaaj", un par NCCIH ki rai ke mutabiq kaafi evidence nahi hai.

Isliye ise ek garam, mazedar mashroob ki tarah lein, dawai ya doctor ke ilaaj ke badle nahi.

4. Supplements aur capsules mein khatray

Khane mein dali jane wali haldi aur capsules mein milne wali tez curcumin mein bohat farq hai. NCCIH ke mutabiq aam tarah ke oral haldi ya curcumin ki sifarish kardah matra 2 se 3 mahine tak aam tor par mehfooz mani jati hai.

Magar zyada jazb hone wale (highly bioavailable) curcumin products se kuch logon mein jigar ko nuqsan ki khabrein aayi hain. Thakan, matli, bhook na lagna, gehra peshab ya jild aur aankhon ka peela hona jaisi alamaat hon to istemal band karein aur doctor se rujoo karein.

Dosre aam asraat mein matli, ulti, pait kharab, tezabiyat, dast ya qabz shamil hain. Jild par lagane se kisi ko khujli ya daane ho sakte hain.

5. Hamal, doodh pilane wali maen aur dawaen

NCCIH ke mutabiq hamal mein haldi ke supplements mehfooz nahi ho sakte. Doodh pilane ke dauran khane mein istemal hone wali matra se zyada ke bare mein bohat kam maloom hai. Khane mein roz marra masale ki matra ki baat alag hai, magar capsules ya bohat zyada matra par pehle doctor se poochein.

Agar aap koi dawai le rahi hain, khaas kar sugar, blood pressure ya khoon patla karne wali, to koi bhi jarri booti shuru karne se pehle doctor ya pharmacist se poochein, kyunke NCCIH ke mutabiq kuch jarri bootiyan dawaon ke saath nuqsan dah taur par takra sakti hain.

6. Rozana zindagi mein sahi istemal

Sab se aasan aur mehfooz tareeqa yeh hai ke haldi ko roz ke khane mein shamil rakhein: daal, sabzi aur salan mein chutki bhar. Ise ek mazedar masale ke taur par dekhein, ilaaj ke taur par nahi.

Supplements par paisa kharch karne se pehle apni khuraak, neend, aur chalne phirne par tawajjo dein. Jodon ke dard ya kisi bhi musalsal takleef ke liye pehle wajah janna zaroori hai.

7. Doctor se kab milein

Agar jodon ka dard hafton se barh raha ho, jigar ya pait ki takleef ho, aap hamal ya doodh pilane ke dauran hon, ya koi dawai le rahi hon aur haldi ke supplement ka soch rahi hon, to pehle doctor se mashwara karein.

Peela rang, gehra peshab ya musalsal thakan jaisi alamaat ko nazar andaaz na karein. Yeh maloomat aam agahi hai aur doctor ke mashware ka mutabadal nahi.

Hawalay (Sources)

  • NIH NCCIH: Turmeric

title: Menopause Ki Alamaat: Kya Normal Hai Aur Is Daur Mein Kya Karein
summary: Menopause aur perimenopause ki aam alamaat, kitni der rehti hain, ghar par kya madad karta hai aur doctor se kab milna chahiye. NHS ke hawalon ke saath.

tableOfContents.title: 3. Yeh daur kitna lamba hota hai
4. Hot flush aur raat ke paseene mein ghar par kya madad karta hai
5. Neend, mood aur haddiyon ka khayal
6. Dawai aur jarri-bootiyon ke bare mein

content:
Key Takeaways

  • NHS ke mutabiq menopause aur perimenopause aam tor par 45 se 55 saal ki umar ke darmiyan hota hai, lekin kisi ko pehle bhi ho sakta hai.
  • Alamaat aam tor par 7 se 9 saal tak rehti hain, kabhi is se zyada bhi.
  • Hot flush, raat ko paseena, neend ki kharabi, mood ki tabdeeli aur periods ka badal jana aam alamaat hain.
  • Menopause ke baad kisi bhi qism ki bleeding, chahe thori hi ho, doctor ko zaroor dikhayein.

1. Menopause aur perimenopause mein farq

Menopause woh waqt hai jab periods hamesha ke liye ruk jate hain. Is se pehle ka daur perimenopause kehlata hai, jab jism ke hormones ghat barh rahe hote hain aur periods be-qaida ho jate hain. Aksar khawateen ko pata hi nahi chalta ke yeh tabdeeliyan isi wajah se hain.

NHS ke mutabiq yeh tabdeeli aam tor par 45 se 55 saal ki umar ke darmiyan aati hai, lekin kisi kisi mein jaldi bhi shuru ho sakti hai. Yani agar aap 42 ya 43 mein hain aur periods badal rahe hain, to yeh dekhna munasib hai, magar sirf is wajah se ghabrane ki zaroorat nahi.

2. Aam alamaat kya hain

NHS ki list ke mutabiq periods ka kam ya zyada, halka ya bhaari ho jana, hot flush (achanak garmi ki lehar) aur raat ko paseena, neend ke masail, mood ki tabdeeli, udaas rehna ya yaadasht aur tawajjo mein kami (brain fog) aam hain.

Is ke ilawa pait aur upar ke jism par wazan barhna, vaginal khushki ya jalan, jodon aur muscles mein dard, baal patle hona, jild khushk hona aur dil ki dhadkan tez mehsoos hona bhi bataya gaya hai. Haddiyon ki density mein kami bhi isi daur ka hissa ho sakti hai.

Zaroori nahi ke har khatoon ko yeh sab ho. Kisi ko bohat halki alamaat hoti hain aur kisi ko roz marra zindagi mein mushkil.

3. Yeh daur kitna lamba hota hai

NHS ke mutabiq alamaat aam tor par 7 se 9 saal tak rehti hain, aur kabhi is se zyada bhi. Yeh waqt ke saath badalti rehti hain. Kuch alamaat, jaise jodon ka dard aur vaginal khushki, menopause ke baad bhi rah sakti hain.

Isliye sabr aur sahi maloomat zaroori hain. Yeh bimari nahi, jism ka ek qudrati marhala hai, lekin is ke asraat ko sambhalne ke tareeqay maujood hain.

4. Hot flush aur raat ke paseene mein ghar par kya madad karta hai

NHS halke aur tah-dar kapde pehnne, kamray ko thanda rakhne, pankhe ya thande paani ka istemal, aur stress kam karne ka mashwara deta hai. Masaledar khana, caffeine (chai, coffee), garam mashroobat, sigaret aur alcohol kuch logon mein hot flush barhate hain, is liye apne triggers pehchan kar unhein kam karein.

Warzish aur sehatmand wazan bhi madad karte hain. Hamare ghar ke hisaab se: raat ko cotton ki chadar, khula hawadar kamra, aur chai ki jagah gunguna paani ya thanda doodh ka option. Ek chhoti diary rakhein jis mein likhein ke kis din kya khaya aur hot flush kab aaya, is se apne triggers samajhna asaan ho jata hai.

5. Neend, mood aur haddiyon ka khayal

Neend ke liye NHS har roz ek jaisa routine rakhne aur jitna ho sake aaram karne ko kehta hai. Mood ke liye aaram, warzish aur sukoon dene wali sargarmiyan madadgar hain. CBT (baat cheet par mabni ek therapy) neend, mood aur hot flush teeno mein madad kar sakti hai.

Haddiyon ke liye NHS weight-bearing aur resistance warzish, calcium wali ghiza jaise doodh, dahi aur hare patte, thori dhoop, aur sigaret chhorne ya alcohol kam karne ka mashwara deta hai. Hamare yahan tez raftar chalna aur seerhiyan chadhna bhi aasaan weight-bearing warzish hain.

6. Dawai aur jarri-bootiyon ke bare mein

Agar alamaat zyada hon to doctor se HRT (hormone replacement therapy) aur dosre options par baat ki ja sakti hai. NHS ke mutabiq HRT haddiyon ke kamzor hone ka khatra bhi kam kar sakti hai, magar yeh hamesha doctor ke mashware se hi shuru ki jati hai. HRT contraception nahi hai, is liye zaroorat ho to us par bhi doctor se baat karein.

Jarri bootiyan ya herbal supplements khud se na shuru karein. NHS bhi kehta hai ke inse pehle doctor se poochein, kyunke woh dosri dawaon se takra sakti hain.

7. Doctor se kab milein

NHS ke mutabiq doctor se milein agar aapko lagta hai ke perimenopause ya menopause ki alamaat hain aur aap options janna chahti hain, dil ki dhadkan tez mehsoos ho, periods pehle se zyada bhaari hon, ya aik saal se periods band hon aur phir bhi kisi bhi qism ki bleeding ho.

Menopause ke baad ki bleeding, chahe thori si ya sirf ek baar hi ho, check zaroor karwayein. Aksar yeh gambhir nahi hoti, lekin kabhi kabhi cancer ki nishani ho sakti hai. Yeh maloomat aam agahi hai aur doctor ke mashware ka mutabadal nahi.

  • NHS: Menopause - things you can do
